policy: Manufacturer specification enrichment is additive only. Official KEA source rows are never modified. Missing or ambiguous manufacturer values remain null. Live source failures keep the last reviewed value and are exposed in status. Only values explicitly confirmed on current manufacturer official pages, catalogs, manuals, or manufacturer heritage specification pages are stored. Variant-dependent dimensions are preserved in the displayed value or an explicit note; values are never inferred from third-party databases.
